title: RoboDexVLM: Visual Language Model-Enabled Task Planning and Motion Control for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
authors: Haichao Liu, Sikai Guo, Pengfei Mai, Jiahang Cao, Haoang Li, Jun Ma

tldr.zh: RoboDexVLM 用 GPT-4o 将语言任务编排为预定义技能序列，通过运动学映射把两指抓取候选用于灵巧手执行，并将执行失败、当前场景和历史送回 VLM 重排技能，实现长序列操作与失败恢复。
tldr.en: RoboDexVLM uses GPT-4o to compose predefined skills from language instructions, maps parallel-gripper grasp proposals to a dexterous hand through kinematics, and feeds execution failures, the current scene and history back to the VLM to replan skills for long-horizon manipulation and recovery.

evaluation_scope.zh: GPT-4o 根据指令、场景、技能清单与记忆输出 8 个原子技能的调用顺序及参数；Grounding DINO＋SAM 定位目标，AnyGrasp 生成抓取候选，经标定映射到多指手，机械臂使用运动学轨迹，手指闭合至设定力阈值。每次技能后用深度变化和手指位置反馈检查结果，错误／图像／历史进入反思提示，从最后成功技能继续，每任务最多恢复三次；反馈修改技能计划与参数，论文未提出新的 RL 或端到端 VLA 动作策略。UR5＋Inspire 五指手＋D435i 真机展示开抽屉取物、容器开盖与水果收纳；代码链接为作者扩展实现。
evaluation_scope.en: GPT-4o receives instructions, scene observations, available skills and memory, and outputs calls and parameters over eight atomic skills. Grounding DINO + SAM localize objects; AnyGrasp proposals are calibrated to the hand, arm motions use kinematic trajectories, and fingers close to a force threshold. Depth changes and finger-position feedback check each skill; errors, images and history prompt replanning from the last successful skill, with at most three recovery attempts per task. Feedback changes skill plans and parameters; no new RL or end-to-end VLA action policy is introduced. UR5 + Inspire five-finger hand + D435i demonstrations include drawer retrieval, lid opening and fruit collection. The linked author repository is an extended implementation.
